decisionBasis: Complete per-format pixel/color/alpha controls; separated observed Main RSS distributions on both Macs; no consistent material write-time regression. Memory is sampled lower-bound observation, not OS pasteboard memory or full-product UI performance.
sourceCheckout: One exact Git revision; Windows raw source hashes reflect verified LF-to-CRLF checkout expansion. Other targets use LF.

report.memoryScope: Outside-process 100 ms sampling of Electron Main during the write handshake; startup, readback, helper processes, OS clipboard server and preparation are excluded. Brief peaks may be missed.
